o: Aren't you going to the festival?
I just asked if you were going to the festival. What's gotten into you?

chat.t: I don't know what I'll do.
All the corruption that's built up inside me...
I can't keep it under control.
But I was happy you came to see me.

o: Call me anytime you need a hand.

chat.t: But what I need isn't help...
I'm holding it back, but if you keep dropping your guard around me...

o: Do I look that delicious to you?
What do I even taste like?

lines.t: I searched all the places Kouchou might be, but there was no sign of her.
Just then...
Is that... a butterfly?
Shrine
A red butterfly appeared.
As if beckoning me to follow...
It fluttered slowly toward the shrine, then vanished.
And then...
I'm here!
!? Y-You...
You thought I'd just sit around after hearing that?
I-I... didn't mean it like that.
How did you find this place?
...Don't look at me.
The butterflies led me here. Like they were saying, "This way!"
I see. The butterflies respond to my feelings...
That was a mistake. If I'd known, I would've tried harder... to keep my feelings in check.
But what's with those horns?
This is... what its influence does to me.
Influence?
On Halloween, the boundary between the living and the dead fades.
All the corruption I've absorbed fighting aberrant spirits...
That power is consuming me.
So... is this a cosplay thing?
No.
Is it contagious?
No, it's not that either.
Oh, then it's no big deal.
...(Twitch)
Corrupting power attracts aberrant spirits and gradually warps its surroundings.
My powers as a shrine maiden... The red butterflies can keep it in check, but not completely.
What do you mean?
...Hah.
I lose control of my emotions. Like this.
Gah!?
Your breath, your scent, every single word you say...
It stirs something inside me... brings it to the surface...
Haa... I want to taste you.
Me?
Yes. From head to toe... every last bit of you... down to your fingertips...
This is why I told you not to come...
It takes everything I have to keep the corrupting power in check. I can't keep myself under control on top of that.
Do you really need to control yourself?
What?
Just follow your heart.
Are you serious?
If you see what I'm really like... how selfish I can be...
You'll end up hating me.
Don't be ridiculous. You could never disappoint me.
But you know...
...What?
That corrupting power basically makes you more honest than usual, right?
Yes. It twists my feelings... I can't hold back like I usually do.
Which means... you've wanted to get closer to me all along, haven't you?
You should've just told me sooner.
N-No... but... this power is dangerous...
The Red Butterflies within me attract aberrant spirits.
That's why I've kept my distance. I didn't want anyone getting hurt.
You're so kind.
Kind...?
No, I... I'm not trying to be kind.
I was afraid of getting hurt.
And scared that other people would get hurt because of me.
That's why even now... I'm terrified.
That you might get hurt because of me...
Go ahead.
Try hurting me.
W-What?!
Why worry so much about things that haven't happened yet?
I'm tougher than you think, you know. Go on, give it your best shot.
Ugh...
If it'll put your mind at ease... I'm game.
...Please leave.
Huh?
I don't want to hear any more.
So please, go. Hurry...
Hurry...!
Something was clearly wrong with the energy coming off Kouchou, so I decided to back off for now.

chat.t: By the way... have you heard of the Quartet Festival?
That energy helps keep corrupting power in check.
Though I hardly ever go myself.

o: Then isn't that exactly what you need right now?
Come on. I'll show you how to have fun at a festival.

lines.t: Festival Street (Night Market)
Did you wait long?
No.
When did you get here?
Six hours ago.
Did I tell you the wrong time...?!
No, it's not that.
My heart was pounding and I just couldn't sit still, so...
I ended up coming early.
Is that the corrupting power at work, too?
Maybe, maybe not.
Hey, don't leave me hanging like that.
Anyway, let's have some fun, like we promised.
Step right up!
Welcome to the test of strength!
Test of strength?
Come on, show us what those muscles can do!
Hit the punching machine and beat our record to win a special prize!
A punching machine, huh... That won't be easy.
Looks easy to me...
Huh? What did you say?
No, nothing...
What's this? Are you chickening out?
Doesn't look like you work out much, either. Haha!
…*Sigh*
WHAM!
Were you always this strong?
Well, the boundary between life and death is a little blurry for me right now, after all.
So... did I beat the record?
Who cares about the record?!
You didn't just break the record... You broke the machine!
Should I... say sorry?
An apology isn't going to cut it!
Pay for it! Pay up!
Um... can we call this one a draw?
A draw, my foot! We haven't even finished paying this thing off!
Aaargh! It's back to living on cheap protein shakes!
Pay for it…?
I know exactly what to do.
You do...?
RUN!
I grabbed Kouchou's hand and we made a run for it.
That was a close one.
Yeah.
...Pfft.
Sorry. It's just... I don't know why, but this is all so funny.
I'm in the Fairwinds Association. We keep the festival safe, but I hardly ever get to enjoy it myself.
My power... and my own feelings... always held me back.
But being here with you is so much fun. It feels like a dream.
Yes. A sweet dream that could end at any moment...
There you go again, talking nonsense.
I'm not some dream. I'm right here, right now.
You can feel my hand in yours, can't you?
Ow! Hey, hey! You're squeezing too hard!
What... is this feeling?
Something's burning deep in my chest... I've never felt anything like it.
What on earth... is happening to me?!
W-Wait. Calm down!
Ugh... Ngh...!
What is this?!
The aberrant spirits... they're crossing the boundary.
We need to get out of here... Now...!
Deep in the Mountains
Now I understand... why I couldn't keep this under control.
It's because of you.
...I'd like a lawyer.
...I'm not blaming you.
Before I met you, I was a tranquil pond.
Still and unchanging, deep in the mountains. Never flowing.
But after meeting you, I became... a rippling lake, a flowing river, a raging sea.
Like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon.
You changed me, <:player>.
So... I can't hold back the tide like I used to.
Then what are we supposed to do?
...That... we'll have to figure out.

o: You actually fell for that? You're too easy.
Anyway, did you send these butterflies?
Even bug spray won't make them leave.

chat.t: They're spiritual entities. Bug spray won't work on them.

o: Even the cutest animals wouldn't be much fun in your living room.

chat.t: But the butterflies reflect what's in my heart.
Make sure you stay inside tonight.
And keep your doors and windows shut tight.

o: What, are you announcing your next crime?

lines.t: Inside the Quartet Room
It was a strange night.
A strange heat spread through me until my whole body was burning up.
Everything felt hazy, almost dreamlike.
I was awake... but not quite.
I tried to shut the door and get some sleep, like Kouchou had warned me to, but...
It's way too hot... A little fresh air couldn't hurt.
The moment I opened the door...
!? W-What?
Kou...chou?
Whoa, you scared me! You could've told me you were coming.
...I warned you.
Warned me?
Yes.
You shouldn't have opened the door.
A door is... a "boundary." It separates one side from the other.
The moment you opened it, that boundary dissolved. Everything started blending together.
Dreams and reality, thoughts and imagination.
If you'd kept the door closed, I might've been able to hold on, but...
Ah... I can't anymore.
Does that mean...
It's your fault. You're the one who wouldn't leave me alone.
These emotions, this heart of mine... Feelings I never should have had...
So now... I have no choice but to do it with you.
Do what?!
That's...
Haa...
Train to keep the corrupting power in check, of course.
Aha, I see!
...Oh. And here I am with my pants down already.
...? Why are your pants down?
Well, uh... I thought you meant something a little more... physical. Biological, even.
...Anyway, right now I'm holding back both my power and my feelings.
But with your help... I could let those feelings out and focus on controlling my power.
That would make the corrupting power easier to purify.
In other words...
You're going to let all those bottled-up feelings loose on me, right?
Yes.
That doesn't sound half bad.
I'd love to see that side of you.
Don't say I didn't warn you.
Because once we start, I won't be able to stop...
That's my line.
Gah!?
...I warned you.
Inside the Quartet Room
Phew, haa...
It's calming down... bit by bit...
What, we're done already?
Yes. I can handle it on my own now...
That's not right.
That's not what you're supposed to say.
How did it feel to finally let it all out?
It felt... good.
I was happy.
I've never been so honest about my feelings before.
So?
Are you just going to go back to how things were?
Just say, "Well, that was a night to remember"?
Then go back... to being all alone?
I... don't want that.
Then what should you say?
<:player>.
The corrupting power inside me... will change me again.
Into someone selfish, someone who hurts you.
Are you really okay with that?
Of course I am!
All right, then...
To keep this power in check and still be myself...
Help me, <:player>.
Well, let's start with another trip to the festival.
What? You said the festive atmosphere helps, didn't you?
Then we should go out more often, right?
Hmm...
Try being a little more honest with yourself.
It'll help you let more of those feelings out.
...Yeah.

chat.t: You promised we'd go to the festival.

o: I'm just a bit busy right now.

chat.t: You're in your room watching dirty stuff, aren't you?

o: You said you wouldn't use your butterflies as security cameras.

chat.t: So are you going to the festival or not?

o: You're the one who wanted it.
Hey, we both agreed to that...

chat.t: I've finally become a proper shrine maiden.
Can you feel what I'm feeling? Through the butterfly...
Feel what I feel. My emotions, my senses, my heart.
Because I'll be feeling you, too.
If you keep teasing me like that...
I might just eat you up.
Just you wait until next time.

lines.t: Festival Street (Night Market)
Have you been waiting long?
No.
When did you get here?
...Maybe thirty minutes ago.
Ooooh!
What's with that reaction?
Nothing. You just seem a little different, that's all.
Anyway, let's get going.
Welcome to the Panoticon stall!
Try Panoticon's services at a special low price!
Panoticon? You're offering prison services... at a festival?
That's right! The Head Maid sent us here to promote Panoticon!
...Huh?
So you're offering a five-star hotel experience... in a prison?
Yes!
...How much is it?
Just this much!
Ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands... millions?!
Are you out of your mind?! Getting arrested is free! How is this affordable?!
Now, now, Master. You have to pay for this kind of service!
Still, it's cheaper than an actual five-star hotel!
Money doesn't grow on trees for us, you know!
Forget it. I'm not interested. I've already seen it all, done it all, tasted it all...
Wait! Now that I look closer... Y-you're...
The legend who overpowered the Head Maid, used her as a chair, and spanked her...?!
You did that...?
Wait. You've got it all wrong.
Ever since then, "Chair Slap Slap" has been on the Head Maid's punishment menu!
This is your fault! She did it to me just yesterday!
Gah...
On a chair... spanking...
I've never tried that... I'm curious...
Uhhh... Kouchou???
Hehe, really? You've never been spanked by hand before?
We get spanked every week!
Is that really something to brag about?
And Kouchou, this is not a competition...
You told me to be honest with myself.
Huh?
So I'm going to be honest.
...I'm curious.
Wow, I didn't see this coming.
I said be honest, not discover a whole new kink...
Are you disappointed?
No! That's not it!
Fine. Okay. I'm on board, but...
Does it really... have to be here?
Yes.
Right in the middle of a festival with people watching?
At a Panoticon prison-experience booth, no less?
Dammit! How am I supposed to say no when you put it like that?!
Here comes Master!
Time for the Panoticon Guard and Inmate Experience!
All right, Master! Say something in character!
S-Say something?
Yes! You've got to get into character!
You're not going to half-ass it after paying that much, are you?  Pffft!
Gah...! Why you little...!
I'm fine with it, so go ahead, <:player>.
<:player>...?
Who do you think you're bossing around, you naughty, masochistic shrine maiden?!
Huh?! Since when does a prisoner get to give Master orders?!
A-Ah!
W-Whoa... He's ruthless... No mercy at all...
So this is the legendary Conqueror of Panoticon... A beast in human form. A total pervert...
Who are you calling a pervert, you damn maids?!
Ngh?! W-Why me...?!
Everyone gets punished, butthead!
Panoticon
Achoo!
...Hm? Why are my ears burning...? Is someone talking about me?
Oh, well. A good spanking will sort them out.
Haah...?!
Now, thank me for your punishment!
Th-Thank you for the p-punishment...?
A butt that luscious? Shameful! Do you plead guilty?!
I-I'm sorry...?
Who said you could talk back?!
Ahh?! Y-You're the one who asked...
Excuses? From a mere butt? The nerve!
Now... tell the truth. Who were you thinking of?
Who were you thinking about last night?!
Th-That's...
I-I was thinking of you...
O-Oh.
L-Louder!
I-I was thinking of you...!
That's more like it! You pass!
Hey, maids! This butt needs a bandage!
R-Right away! One Panoticon Special Bandage, coming right up!
Thank you for your patronage!
Hey.
Let's... come again.
...Yeah.
But hey.
Next time... let's find somewhere a little more private...
I mean... it's not that I didn't like it. It's just a little embarrassing. Just a little.

chat.t: As the blurred boundaries become clear,
And butterflies take flight above the tranquil waters,

o: Arise, warrior of the Red Butterfly.
Sorry, it just sounded like song lyrics.

chat.t: Anyway, I'll send you the location, so meet me there.
I need to ask you something.

o: It might take a bit. I'm in the middle of something.

chat.t: You're just watching dirty stuff in your room.
Mmh, so that's what you're into.

o: Quit using those butterflies as security cameras.

chat.t: If you want it to stop, help me sort things out here first.
I've got the corrupting power completely under control.
What happened last time won't happen again.

o: I actually liked hearing you beg, "I can't take any more!"
Really? Guess I won't need those new tools I bought, then?
So? Did you or didn't you?

chat.t: You're even worse than I thought.

lines.t: Shrine
This place is...
Where we'll perform the ritual.
A ritual?
Yes. Like I said, just suppressing it won't solve anything now.
So... I'll draw out the urges buried deep in my heart along with the corrupting power, then purify them together.
That's why...
I need you.
What exactly do you need me to do?
It's simple.
Even if my emotions overflow... even if my heart spills over... don't let me fall apart.
Help me stay true to myself.
This is... something only you can do, <:player>.
Well, I can't say no to that. But what do I actually do?
You've told me the goal, but not how to get there.
That... you'll know when the time comes.
But there's one condition.
A condition?
Yes. For both our sakes.
If you don't stick to it, there's no telling what might happen to either of us.
Don't keep me in suspense. Just tell me.
Do you really think I'd back out after coming this far?
Hehe... You're right. You've always been like that.
The condition is... never stop.
No matter what I say,
No matter what look is on my face.
Until the very end—don't stop.
Even if you beg?
Even if I beg.
You better not regret it.
Same to you.
Hahaha!
Pfft...
Then I'll head inside first.
I'll leave the barrier open, so...
Come in when you're ready.
Can I take my time?
Suit yourself. But...
If you take too long... I really might not be able to come back.
Shrine
Phew...
Post-nut clarity?
No.
Actually... you're half right.
The feelings are still there, but they don't overflow anymore. It's like...
The water's still there, but the vessel holding it has grown.
Still, who knew a spanking at a festival would lead to all this...
You really never know what life has in store.
Pfft... You're right.
So. How do you feel?
Like a potter gently shaping clay...
You reshaped me, <:player>.
Just as you desired, with your own hands, into the shape you wanted...
I feel like I've been reborn.
...Was what I did really that special?
Yes.
You helped me stay true to myself.
You kept me from giving in to the corrupting power.
And...
You let me feel things I'd never felt before.
Though... it did hurt a little...
Remind me, who was it who told me not to stop?
Th-That was...
Want to do it again?
...Yes.
As long as you're okay with it, <:player>...
